dedupe_keys.name: 15 minute measurement datasets from 49 residential apartments in hot and humid climates for hygrothermal building simulation and occupant behavior studies

description: Yuanchen Wang and co-authors publish measurements from 49 Hanoi apartments through Mendeley Data as part of CAMaRSEC. Version 2 covers June 2020 to June 2021. Indoor temperature, humidity, pressure and carbon-dioxide concentration were measured every fifteen minutes. A weather station at Hanoi University of Civil Engineering supplied outdoor conditions every five minutes. Occupancy and air-conditioning operation were inferred from indoor measurements. Most apartments have bedroom and living-room series; apartments 41 and 42 contain only living-room data. The provider explicitly identifies hygrothermal building simulation and occupant-behaviour research as uses. The public deposit is free under CC BY 4.0; file formats were not established from the inspected metadata. PADELF supplied the discovery link, but these are environmental and derived behaviour measurements, with no electricity-load measurement established by the provider description. No related catalogue resource was identified. Data files were not downloaded.
name: 15-minute measurement datasets from 49 residential apartments in hot and humid climates for hygrothermal building simulation and occupant behavior studies
notes: Simulation-use tags are catalogue classifications. Provider metadata establishes the physical measurements and intended uses; suitability for a specific model was not tested. Outdoor weather measurements have a five-minute interval. Outdoor weather measurements have a five-minute interval.
